title: Soft Layered Chapati
description:
Ingredients
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 3 tbsp oil, plus extra for brushing
- About 1 cup warm water

Method
1. Mix the flour, salt and sugar. Add the oil and rub it in with your fingers.
2. Add warm water a little at a time and knead for 8 to 10 minutes into a soft, smooth dough. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
3. Divide into 8 balls. Roll each one thin, brush with oil, roll it up like a rope and coil it into a snail. Rest 10 minutes.
4. Roll each coil into a circle and cook in a hot dry pan, about 1 minute a side, then brush lightly with oil and cook until golden spots appear.
5. Stack the chapatis under a clean towel so they stay soft.

title: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
description:
Ingredients
- 1 whole chicken (about 1.5 kg)
- 2 lemons, halved
- 1 head of garlic, halved across
- 3 tbsp butter, softened
- 1 tsp paprika
- Fresh thyme, salt and pepper

Method
1. Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat the chicken dry.
2. Mix the butter, paprika, salt and pepper and rub it all over and under the skin.
3. Put one lemon half and a few thyme sprigs inside. Arrange the rest of the lemon and the garlic around the chicken in a roasting dish.
4. Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes, basting halfway, until the juices run clear.
5. Rest for 10 minutes, then squeeze the roasted lemon over before carving.

title: One-Pot Creamy Garlic Spaghetti
description:
Ingredients
- 250 g spaghetti
- 2 tbsp butter
- 4 cloves garlic, sliced
- 3 cups chicken or vegetable stock
- 1/2 cup cream
- 1/2 cup grated parmesan
- Black pepper, parsley

Method
1. Melt the butter in a wide pot and fry the garlic gently until fragrant.
2. Add the stock and bring to the boil, then add the spaghetti.
3. Simmer, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed (about 12 minutes).
4. Stir in the cream and parmesan, season with pepper and finish with parsley.

title: Weeknight Spaghetti Bolognese
description:
Ingredients
- 500 g minced beef
- 1 onion, 1 carrot and 1 celery stick, finely chopped
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 can chopped tomatoes
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 1 tsp dried oregano
- 400 g spaghetti, parmesan to serve

Method
1. Brown the mince in a large pan, then lift it out.
2. Soften the onion, carrot and celery, add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for a minute.
3. Return the meat, add the tomatoes, oregano and half a can of water. Simmer for 30 minutes.
4. Boil the spaghetti in salted water, toss with the sauce and top with parmesan.

title: Masala Chips
description:
Ingredients
- 4 large potatoes, cut into chips
- Oil for frying
- 1 onion, finely chopped
- 2 tomatoes, finely chopped
- 1 tsp garam masala
- 1/2 tsp chilli powder
- 2 tbsp tomato sauce, lemon juice, coriander

Method
1. Soak the chips in cold water for 20 minutes, then dry them very well.
2. Fry at a medium heat until soft, drain, then fry again in hotter oil until crisp and golden.
3. In a pan, cook the onion, tomatoes and spices into a thick sauce with the tomato sauce.
4. Toss the hot chips in the sauce, squeeze over lemon and top with coriander.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pie
description:
Ingredients
- 1 ready-made pie crust
- 2 cups mashed cooked sweet potato
- 1/2 cup brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 3/4 cup milk
- 2 tbsp melted butter
- 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, 1 tsp vanilla

Method
1. Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a pie dish with the crust.
2. Whisk everything else together until smooth.
3. Pour into the crust and bake for 50 to 55 minutes, until just set in the middle.
4. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Simple Baked Cheesecake
description:
Ingredients
- 200 g digestive biscuits, crushed
- 80 g butter, melted
- 600 g cream cheese, room temperature
- 3/4 cup sugar
- 3 eggs
- 1 cup sour cream
- 1 tsp vanilla, zest of 1 lemon

Method
1. Heat the oven to 160°C (325°F). Mix the biscuits and butter and press into a lined springform tin.
2. Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
3. Stir in the sour cream, vanilla and lemon zest, and pour over the base.
4. Bake for 55 minutes, until the edges are set but the centre still wobbles.
5. Turn the oven off and leave the cheesecake inside for an hour, then chill overnight.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken Kiev
description:
Ingredients
- 4 chicken breasts
- 100 g butter, softened
- 3 cloves garlic, crushed
- 2 tbsp chopped parsley
- 1/2 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
- Oil for frying

Method
1. Mix the butter, garlic and parsley, shape into 4 logs and freeze for 20 minutes.
2. Cut a deep pocket into the side of each breast and tuck in a butter log. Press the edges closed.
3. Coat each one in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs. Repeat the egg and crumbs for a sealed crust.
4. Shallow fry until golden on all sides, then finish in a 200°C (400°F) oven for 15 minutes.

title: Cajun Seafood Boil
description:
Ingredients
- 500 g large prawns, shell on
- 2 corn cobs, cut in thirds
- 500 g small potatoes
- 1 smoked sausage, sliced
- 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
- 100 g butter, 4 cloves garlic, 1 lemon

Method
1. Boil a big pot of water with 1 tbsp of the Cajun seasoning and the lemon halves.
2. Cook the potatoes for 12 minutes, then add the corn and sausage for 5 minutes.
3. Add the prawns for the last 3 minutes, until pink. Drain.
4. Melt the butter with the garlic and the rest of the seasoning, pour over everything and toss.

title: Pan-Seared Steak with Herb Oil
description:
Ingredients
- 2 sirloin steaks, about 3 cm thick
- Salt and coarse black pepper
- 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp butter
- Herb oil: 1/4 cup olive oil, a handful of parsley, 1 clove garlic, 1 tbsp vinegar

Method
1. Take the steaks out of the fridge 30 minutes early and season well.
2. Blitz or finely chop the herb oil ingredients and season.
3. Sear the steaks in a very hot pan with the oil, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Add the butter for the last minute and baste.
4. Rest for 5 minutes, slice, and spoon the herb oil over.

title: Golden Crab Cakes
description:
Ingredients
- 400 g crab meat
- 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
- 1 egg
- 2 tbsp mayonnaise
- 1 tsp mustard
- 2 spring onions, chopped
- Lemon wedges to serve

Method
1. Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a tray.
2. Gently mix everything except the lemon, keeping the crab in chunks.
3. Shape into 8 patties and chill for 20 minutes so they hold together.
4. Brush with a little oil and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until golden. Serve with lemon.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
description:
Ingredients
- 115 g butter, melted
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup white sugar
- 1 egg, 1 tsp vanilla
- 1 1/4 cups flour
- 1/2 tsp baking soda, pinch of salt
- 1 cup chocolate chips

Method
1. Whisk the butter and sugars, then the egg and vanilla.
2. Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips. Chill for 30 minutes.
3. Scoop onto a lined tray, leaving room to spread.
4. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 10 to 11 minutes, until the edges are golden but the middles look soft. Cool on the tray.
